notes: Author-manuscript layout of a primary research article; no retraction notice in the PDF and is_retracted false. Sorbents: zeolite-templated carbon CEMC and Pt-decorated carbons Pt5CEMC/Pt10CEMC (nominal 5 and 10 wt% Pt, so majority carbon). Gravimetric IGA-003 with stated buoyancy correction (p. 15); isotherms to 20 bar at 77 and 298 K (Fig. 6) and 87 and 308 K for CEMC and Pt5CEMC (Fig. 7). BET (P/P0 0.02-0.22, N2 at 77 K) stated p. 5. Text and Table 1 disagree on some textural values (CEMC pore volume 1.91 text vs 1.71 table; Pt5CEMC area 2049 vs 2047; Pt10CEMC area 1249 vs 1279); not relevant to eligibility but relevant to extraction. No statement that the uptake values were published before.
